description: This file defines classes for socket-based input streams in Apache Spark Streaming, including a DStream for socket input and a receiver that manages socket connections and data reception.

classes.name: SocketInputDStream
classes.description: A DStream that receives data from a socket connection, creating a socket receiver.

classes.name: SocketReceiver
classes.description: A Spark Streaming receiver that manages socket connection, data reception, and error handling.

methods.name: getReceiver
methods.description: Returns a new instance of SocketReceiver for this DStream.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Establishes socket connection and starts data reception thread.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Closes socket connection and cleans up resources.

methods.name: receive
methods.description: Receives data from socket input stream and stores it into Spark.

methods.name: bytesToLines
methods.description: Converts an InputStream into an iterator of newline-delimited strings.
